steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the tenant capability required for the Price Cap column.
Change the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique value.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product to the first sheet row.
Confirm the requested product was added.
Verify the product variant auto-fills as specified.
Enter the requested quantity.
Confirm the quantity is retained.
Choose the specified delivery location.
Confirm the delivery location selection.
Open the sheet's extra-column selector.
Add the Price Cap column.
Verify the Price Cap column is rendered.
Enter the valid price cap.
Confirm that 100 is accepted and retained.
Try entering letters into the price cap field.
Verify the nonnumeric price cap is refused.
Try entering a negative price cap.
Verify the negative price cap is not retained.
Check the required negative-cap validation message.
